items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Arthur played all over Lonnie with Arthur taken sick and had to leave.

ctx.x: Henry Turner was his name. Yeah. Henry Johnson, Henry Turner. Yeah. And, alright, let's look at the reeds now. What about your altos? Which ones? The first was Arthur Dermy. Well, alright, your first was Arthur Dermy. Oh, the first was Arthur Dermy. Yeah, I know about him playing around here.
Yeah, well, Arthur played all over Lonnie with Arthur taken sick and had to leave.
And he... When I knew him, I just knew him and it wasn't far from here. I guess he had a restaurant on St. Bernard.
